result.description:
SMW-Shutdowns, Maintenance & Welding provides a one vendor solution for mining, industry and defence. We’re a future-focused, diversified services provider with over 20 years of industry expertise. If you show us a problem in your operation, we’ll create a solution. Our team works to engineer continuous improvement across all of the SMW Companies, striving to bring our best no matter the job.

Solving your engineering challenges is second nature to SMW – our people have been engineering continuous improvement for our clients for over 20 years. With a huge diversity of industry expertise under one future-focused banner, the SMW delivers your one vendor solution.

We are seeking highly skilled and experienced PAINTER to join our team of professionals on a full-time and permanent basis.

The successful candidates must have a positive and enthusiastic attitude. Candidates are expected to be able to work safely with minimal supervision and must demonstrate quality workmanship which meets or exceeds business requirements.

To be considered for the Role, applicants must:
Professional paint finishes on all sizes and types of heavy equipment
Understand surface preparation and finishes
Be able to understand and complete works to specifications
Be able to mix to correct ratio two-part paint coatings etc.
Select paints, varnishes and stains to various surfaces using brushes, sprays, and rollers
Understand the use of Wet Film Thickness Gauges and be able to achieve specified dry film thickness
Be able to work at heights and in confined spaces
Erecting scaffolding and ladders
Cleaning equipment and work areas
Outstanding communication skills
The ability to work as rostered and be on time is ESSENTIAL
The capacity to paint successfully to specification with a spray gun (Mainly pump and hand guns)
The ability to produce a near automotive finish for mobile plant and equipment
The ability to Produce a quality finish always
Work in a professional and safe manner
Understanding of WHS requirements compliance, and the correct use of PPE
Great problem-solving skills
Car license
Forklift license preferable
The ability to follow instructions and ask questions to clarify

If you possess the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then please apply now!
Salary: Between $75,000 and $80,000 per annum + Super

THE REALISE GROUP | FLEXIBLE, PAID ASSIGNMENTS

Looking for flexible work you can fit around your lifestyle?
 
The Realise Group is seeking reliable, detail-oriented individuals to join our national network of Mystery Shoppers. Complete visits undercover as a regular customer, then fill in a survey providing structured, factual feedback about your experience. Your feedback enables organisations to improve service standards, team performance, and overall customer satisfaction.
 
WHAT A MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES:
 
Visit retail stores, cafés, restaurants, pharmacies, shopping centres and a variety of other businesses
Visits may be in-store, or occasionally may involve phone or website enquiries
Observe service, selling skills, promotions, presentation and cleanliness standards
Submit clear online reports after each assignment
 
Full instructions are provided for every job.
 
WHAT MAKES A GOOD MYSTERY SHOPPER:
 
Paying attention to detail                                                                                                   
Able to follow detailed instructions 
Clear written communication 
Comfortable using a smartphone and computer 
Reliable and able to meet deadlines
 
No previous experience required.
 
GET PAID PER ASSIGNMENT:
 
Payment is typically $15–$50+ per assignment plus
Reimbursement for required purchases (in addition to your payment)
Payment made via direct debit to your bank account (no points, credits, vouchers or PayPal payments, just real cash!)
 
JOIN OUR TEAM:
If you enjoy independent work and want flexible, paid assignments, apply today to join The Realise Group’s Mystery Shopper network.
 
APPLY HERE and read more info: https://therealisegroup.com.au/become-a-mystery-shopper

Harrybilt Engineering & Welding Services is the supplier of choice all over Australia for Road Rail Trucks, Excavators and Trailers, along with Rail Maintenance Attachments and Work Tools. We are currently seeking to recruit several experienced and qualified Welders / Metal Fabricators to join our factory in Wendouree VIC. 

 Successful candidates will need to undertake and possess:

-  Interpret blueprints, drawings, and measurements to plan layouts
-  Proficiency in MIG, TIG and Arc welding
-  Use specialized machinery for industrial welding and oversee machines that perform the same job
-  Maintain and repair all machinery
-  Assess welded surfaces, structures and components to identify errors
-  Follow and enforce strict safety regulations
-  Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
-  Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions
 

Skills and abilities:

-  Knowledge of Welding tools and equipment
-  Mathematical Skills
-  Attention to Detail
-  Steady Hands and Good Hand-Eye Coordination.
-  Physical Strength and Endurance
-  Problem solving
-  Good Communication and Teamwork Abilities
 

Qualifications:

-  Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (MEM30305) or relevant
-  Work Experience at least 3 years


Salary range is $70,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with skills and experience

Several Full-time Positions available  
 
Applications open on 8th of July 2026 and closes on 8th of August 2026.

Lucan Engineering are currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Metal Machinist to join their team in Lidcombe NSW 2141.

- Study and read drawings and specifications to determine suitable material, method and sequence of operations and machine settings
- Fit fabricated metal parts into products and assembling metal parts to produce machines and equipment
